label.cy: Cyfansawdd cymwys cyntaf ar ôl yr adroddiad

description.en: A rolling satellite feed, mutually exclusive change views and a separate historic EFFIS interpretation
description.cy: Ffrwd loeren dreigl, golygon newid sy’n eithrio ei gilydd a dehongliad EFFIS hanesyddol ar wahân

description.en: Dated sources that are not current condition
description.cy: Ffynonellau â dyddiad nad ydynt yn gyflwr presennol

description.en: A separately operated 24-hour view of recent NOAA-21 and NOAA-20 VIIRS thermal-anomaly observations, with a filterable 30-day history.
description.cy: Golwg 24 awr a weithredir ar wahân o arsylwadau anomaledd thermol VIIRS NOAA-21 a NOAA-20 diweddar, gyda hanes 30 diwrnod y gellir ei hidlo.

layers.provider: NASA FIRMS, VIIRS NOAA-21 and NOAA-20
layers.attribution: Data: NASA FIRMS, VIIRS NOAA-21 and NOAA-20. Clipped and reformatted by Blorenge Commoners Association.

evidenceStatus.en: Operational satellite observations — freshness is shown live and detections are not verified incidents
evidenceStatus.cy: Arsylwadau lloeren gweithredol — dangosir ffresni’n fyw ac nid digwyddiadau wedi’u cadarnhau yw canfyddiadau

sourceDate.en: Rolling 24-hour map and 30-day history; observation and publication times are shown with feed health
sourceDate.cy: Map 24 awr treigl a hanes 30 diwrnod; dangosir amseroedd arsylwi a chyhoeddi gyda iechyd y ffrwd

layers.licence: NASA FIRMS terms and BCA publication authority
layers.nextReviewAt: Continuous monitoring; contract review on source change

method.en: Query only VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT and VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT every six hours, validate and exact-clip observation centroids to the release AOI, then atomically publish checksum-addressed snapshots.
method.cy: Ymholi dim ond VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT a VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT bob chwe awr, dilysu a chlipio canolbwyntiau arsylwi’n union i AOI y rhyddhad, yna cyhoeddi cipluniau â chyfeiriad checksum yn atomig.

limitations.en: A point is the centre of a nominal approximately 375 m observation pixel, not an exact heat or fire location or extent.
limitations.cy: Canol picsel arsylwi enwol tua 375 m yw pwynt, nid union leoliad nac arwynebedd gwres neu dân.

limitations.en: A detection is not a verified incident, perimeter, warning, severity measure or forecast; absence of detections is not evidence that no fire exists.
limitations.cy: Nid digwyddiad wedi’i gadarnhau, terfyn, rhybudd, mesur difrifoldeb na rhagolwg yw canfyddiad; nid yw diffyg canfyddiadau’n dystiolaeth nad oes tân.

limitations.en: Do not travel to investigate. Report immediate danger through 999 or 112.
limitations.cy: Peidiwch â theithio i ymchwilio. Rhowch wybod am berygl uniongyrchol drwy 999 neu 112.

name.cy: Newid arwyneb a llystyfiant a welwyd

description.en: A conservative, uncalibrated comparison of valid Sentinel-2 observations, independently checked where Landsat was observable.
description.cy: Cymhariaeth geidwadol heb ei graddnodi o arsylwadau Sentinel-2 dilys, wedi’i gwirio’n annibynnol lle roedd Landsat yn weladwy.

layers.provider: Copernicus Sentinel-2, USGS Landsat and BCA processing
layers.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025–2026; Landsat imagery courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

evidenceStatus.en: Versioned derived observation — not ecological recovery or a severity class
evidenceStatus.cy: Arsylwad deilliedig â fersiwn — nid adferiad ecolegol na dosbarth difrifoldeb

sourceDate.en: 12 July 2025, 12 July 2026 and 29 July / 11 August 2026 composite
sourceDate.cy: 12 Gorffennaf 2025, 12 Gorffennaf 2026 a chyfansawdd 29 Gorffennaf / 11 Awst 2026

layers.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice; USGS public domain

method.en: Mask the two post observations independently, use valid 29 July pixels before 11 August fill, require three-role comparability and calculate continuous dNBR, NDVI and NDMI before displaying conservative evidence states. Landsat corroboration remains separate and is not fused.
method.cy: Masgio’r ddau arsylwad ôl-adroddiad yn annibynnol, defnyddio picseli dilys 29 Gorffennaf cyn llenwad 11 Awst, mynnu cymaroldeb tair rôl a chyfrifo dNBR, NDVI ac NDMI parhaus cyn dangos cyflyrau tystiolaeth geidwadol. Mae cadarnhad Landsat yn aros ar wahân ac nid yw wedi’i uno.

limitations.en: Observed change is not proof of ecological recovery, habitat condition, cause or local severity.
limitations.cy: Nid yw newid a welwyd yn brawf o adferiad ecolegol, cyflwr cynefin, achos na difrifoldeb lleol.

limitations.en: Pixels invalid on both 29 July and 11 August remain Not observed, never no change.
limitations.cy: Mae picseli annilys ar 29 Gorffennaf ac 11 Awst yn aros Heb eu harsylwi, byth yn ddim newid.

description.en: A neutral signed difference in the vegetation greenness index across the release AOI; negative is lower and positive is higher.
description.cy: Gwahaniaeth niwtral ag arwydd ym mynegai gwyrddni llystyfiant ar draws AOI y rhyddhad; mae negyddol yn is a phositif yn uwch.

layers.provider: European Union Copernicus programme and BCA processing
layers.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025–2026; processing by Blorenge Commoners Association

evidenceStatus.en: Versioned 10 m signed index difference — not a fire, recovery or severity measure
evidenceStatus.cy: Gwahaniaeth mynegai 10 m ag arwydd ac â fersiwn — nid mesur tân, adferiad na difrifoldeb

sourceDate.en: NDVI(29 July / 11 August 2026 composite) minus NDVI(12 July 2025)
sourceDate.cy: NDVI(cyfansawdd 29 Gorffennaf / 11 Awst 2026) llai NDVI(12 Gorffennaf 2025)

layers.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice and BCA publication authority

method.en: Calculate (B8 - B4) / (B8 + B4) at native 10 m after the common mask; use 29 July where independently valid, otherwise 11 August, otherwise Not observed.
method.cy: Cyfrifo (B8 - B4) / (B8 + B4) ar 10 m brodorol ar ôl y masg cyffredin; defnyddio 29 Gorffennaf lle mae’n ddilys yn annibynnol, neu 11 Awst fel arall, neu Heb ei arsylwi.

limitations.en: The difference does not establish cause, fire damage, severity, habitat condition or recovery.
limitations.cy: Nid yw’r gwahaniaeth yn sefydlu achos, difrod tân, difrifoldeb, cyflwr cynefin nac adferiad.

limitations.en: Rainfall, phenology, grazing, management and residual observation effects may contribute; Not observed is not zero change.
limitations.cy: Gall glawiad, ffenoleg, pori, rheolaeth ac effeithiau arsylwi gweddilliol gyfrannu; nid yw Heb ei arsylwi yn ddim newid.

name.cy: Newid mynegai sy’n sensitif i leithder (NDMI)

description.en: A neutral signed difference in a moisture-sensitive vegetation index across the release AOI; negative is lower and positive is higher.
description.cy: Gwahaniaeth niwtral ag arwydd mewn mynegai llystyfiant sy’n sensitif i leithder ar draws AOI y rhyddhad; mae negyddol yn is a phositif yn uwch.

layers.provider: European Union Copernicus programme and BCA processing
layers.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025–2026; processing by Blorenge Commoners Association

evidenceStatus.en: Versioned 20 m signed index difference — not dryness, fire, recovery or severity
evidenceStatus.cy: Gwahaniaeth mynegai 20 m ag arwydd ac â fersiwn — nid sychder, tân, adferiad na difrifoldeb

sourceDate.en: NDMI(29 July / 11 August 2026 composite) minus NDMI(12 July 2025)
sourceDate.cy: NDMI(cyfansawdd 29 Gorffennaf / 11 Awst 2026) llai NDMI(12 Gorffennaf 2025)

layers.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice and BCA publication authority

method.en: Calculate (B8A - B11) / (B8A + B11) at native 20 m after the common mask; use 29 July where independently valid, otherwise 11 August, otherwise Not observed.
method.cy: Cyfrifo (B8A - B11) / (B8A + B11) ar 20 m brodorol ar ôl y masg cyffredin; defnyddio 29 Gorffennaf lle mae’n ddilys yn annibynnol, neu 11 Awst fel arall, neu Heb ei arsylwi.

limitations.en: The difference does not establish cause, fire damage, severity, dryness, wetness, habitat condition or recovery.
limitations.cy: Nid yw’r gwahaniaeth yn sefydlu achos, difrod tân, difrifoldeb, sychder, gwlybaniaeth, cyflwr cynefin nac adferiad.

limitations.en: Rainfall, phenology, grazing, management and residual observation effects may contribute; Not observed is not zero change.
limitations.cy: Gall glawiad, ffenoleg, pori, rheolaeth ac effeithiau arsylwi gweddilliol gyfrannu; nid yw Heb ei arsylwi yn ddim newid.

description.en: Checksum-pinned historic EFFIS feature 592404 is shown separately from change evidence and rolling thermal-anomaly points.
description.cy: Dangosir nodwedd EFFIS hanesyddol 592404 â checksum wedi’i binio ar wahân i dystiolaeth newid a phwyntiau anomaledd thermol treigl.

layers.attribution: European Union, Copernicus EFFIS; clipping by Blorenge Commoners Association

evidenceStatus.en: Provisional provider interpretation — not an authority or surveyed perimeter
evidenceStatus.cy: Dehongliad dros dro gan ddarparwr — nid terfyn awdurdod nac arolwg

sourceDate.en: Historic feature 592404 retained from 13 August 2026 acquisition; provider no longer returns that identifier
sourceDate.cy: Nodwedd hanesyddol 592404 a gedwir o gaffaeliad 13 Awst 2026; nid yw’r darparwr bellach yn dychwelyd y dynodwr hwnnw

method.en: Retain the checksum-pinned historic provider feature and clip only its display geometry; record geometry-identical 627416 only as a BCA-inferred re-key, not a provider crosswalk.
method.cy: Cadw’r nodwedd darparwr hanesyddol â checksum wedi’i binio a chlipio ei geometreg arddangos yn unig; cofnodi 627416 â geometreg union yr un fath dim ond fel ailallweddiad a gasglwyd gan BCA, nid croesgyfeiriad darparwr.

limitations.en: No incident-authority, legal or surveyed fire perimeter is available.
limitations.cy: Nid oes terfyn tân gan awdurdod y digwyddiad, terfyn cyfreithiol na therfyn wedi’i arolygu ar gael.

limitations.en: Provider dates are not authority incident times; EFFIS no longer returns feature 592404 and publishes no authoritative crosswalk to 627416.
limitations.cy: Nid amseroedd digwyddiad awdurdod yw dyddiadau’r darparwr; nid yw EFFIS bellach yn dychwelyd nodwedd 592404 ac nid yw’n cyhoeddi croesgyfeiriad awdurdodol i 627416.

name.cy: SoDdGA y Blorens a’r Parc Cenedlaethol

description.en: The independent authoritative protected-site and National Park context, shown with the approximate BCA-area of interest core outline.
description.cy: Cyd-destun awdurdodol annibynnol y safle gwarchodedig a’r Parc Cenedlaethol, wedi’i ddangos gydag amlinell graidd fras Ardal o ddiddordeb BCA.

layers.attribution: Contains Natural Resources Wales information and Ordnance Survey data under OGL 3.0

evidenceStatus.en: Authoritative designation context; the BCA core is approximate and non-legal
evidenceStatus.cy: Cyd-destun dynodi awdurdodol; mae craidd BCA yn fras ac nid yw’n ffin gyfreithiol

sourceDate.en: BCA core version 2026-08-21.1; NRW sources retrieved 21 August 2026
sourceDate.cy: Fersiwn craidd BCA 2026-08-21.1; ffynonellau CNC a adalwyd 21 Awst 2026

method.en: Preserve canonical BCA-area version 2026-08-21.1, derive its exact 2 km AOI in EPSG:27700 and independently clip allowlisted NRW fields.
method.cy: Cadw fersiwn ganonaidd Ardal BCA 2026-08-21.1, deillio ei AOI union 2 km yn EPSG:27700 a chlipio meysydd CNC a ganiateir yn annibynnol.

limitations.en: The BCA-area is approximate and is not the legal, official, surveyed or current CL18 boundary; the SSSI remains independent authoritative context.
limitations.cy: Mae Ardal BCA yn fras ac nid dyma ffin gyfreithiol, swyddogol, wedi’i harolygu na chyfredol CL18; mae’r SoDdGA yn aros yn gyd-destun awdurdodol annibynnol.

description.en: A dated OpenStreetMap snapshot for orientation.
description.cy: Ciplun OpenStreetMap â dyddiad ar gyfer cyfeiriadedd.

method.en: Clip selected place and path fields to the launch area.
method.cy: Clipio meysydd lleoedd a llwybrau dethol i ardal y lansiad.

limitations.en: Paths are contextual and do not establish legal public-rights-of-way status.
limitations.cy: Mae llwybrau yn gyd-destunol ac nid ydynt yn sefydlu statws hawl tramwy cyhoeddus cyfreithiol.

description.en: Named NRW main-river context within the launch area.
description.cy: Cyd-destun prif afonydd CNC ag enwau o fewn ardal y lansiad.

layers.attribution: Contains Natural Resources Wales information and Ordnance Survey data under OGL 3.0

method.en: Clip allowlisted main-river features to the launch area.
method.cy: Clipio nodweddion prif afonydd a ganiateir i ardal y lansiad.

limitations.en: This is landscape context, not live flood or water-quality information.
limitations.cy: Cyd-destun tirwedd yw hwn, nid gwybodaeth fyw am lifogydd nac ansawdd dŵr.

description.en: A fixed hillshade and contours derived from Welsh Government LiDAR.
description.cy: Cysgodwedd sefydlog a chyfuchliniau wedi’u deillio o LiDAR Llywodraeth Cymru.

layers.nextReviewAt: Review on source or contract change

method.en: Average exact intersecting 1 m DTM tiles to 10 m, then derive fixed hillshade and 10 m contours.
method.cy: Cyfartaleddu teils DTM 1 m union sy’n croestorri i 10 m, yna deillio cysgodwedd sefydlog a chyfuchliniau 10 m.

limitations.en: Capture dates vary by tile; hillshade is a visualisation and does not describe current surface cover.
limitations.cy: Mae dyddiadau cofnodi’n amrywio fesul teil; delweddiad yw’r cysgodwedd ac nid yw’n disgrifio gorchudd presennol yr arwyneb.

description.en: A dated survey layer that must not be read as current habitat condition.
description.cy: Haen arolwg â dyddiad na ddylid ei darllen fel cyflwr cynefin presennol.

layers.attribution: Contains Natural Resources Wales information and Ordnance Survey data under OGL 3.0
layers.nextReviewAt: Review on source or contract change

method.en: Clip the recorded Phase 1 habitat polygons to the launch area.
method.cy: Clipio’r polygonau cynefinoedd Cam 1 a gofnodwyd i ardal y lansiad.

limitations.en: The survey does not describe current habitat condition or ecological recovery.
limitations.cy: Nid yw’r arolwg yn disgrifio cyflwr cynefin presennol nac adferiad ecolegol.

claim: Satellite observations show surface and vegetation change consistent with the documented July 2026 Blaenavon wildfire; component index changes do not establish cause.

incident.chronology: Active and under containment operations on 23 July; work and a holding perimeter line were reported on 27 July.
incident.unknowns: No authority stop time, surveyed perimeter or cause is available.

evidenceStates.meaning: A quality mask prevents comparison; this is never no change.
A valid comparison exists but the conservative change rule is not met.
dNBR and NDVI indicate change; the moisture-sensitive indicator does not agree.
dNBR, NDVI and NDMI agree on observed surface and vegetation change.

limitations: Observed change is not proof of ecological recovery or habitat condition.
Component NDVI and NDMI differences do not establish cause, fire damage, severity, dryness or wetness.
No exact, legal, surveyed or incident-authority fire perimeter is available.
The evidence-state thresholds are conservative and are not locally calibrated severity classes.
The BCA-area of interest is approximate and is not the legal, official, surveyed or current CL18 boundary.
Recent thermal anomalies are satellite pixel-centre observations, not verified incidents, exact locations, perimeters or warnings; absence is not evidence that no fire exists.
Paths are contextual and do not establish legal public-rights-of-way status.
Historical habitat does not describe current condition or recovery.
